Technology stocks were posting strong gains in recent trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding almost 0.7% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was roaring nearly 2.0% higher.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Fabrinet ( FN ) touched an 18-month high, rising over 9% to reach its best share price since February 2017 at $48.05 a share, after reporting above-consensus financial results for its fiscal Q4 and projecting Q1 net income topping analyst estimates. Excluding one-time items, the optical packaging company earned $0.81 per share during the three months ended June 29 on $345.3 million in revenue, exceeding Street views by $0.06 per share and $7.2 million, respectively. It also sees adjusted Q1 earnings in a range of $0.80 to $0.83 per share, topping the Capital IQ consensus by at least $0.01 per share. Despite the upbeat financial results and forecast, analysts at Needham & Co lowered their rating for Fabrient shares to Buy from Strong Buy.
In other sector news:
+ United Technologies ( UTX ) was hanging on to a slim rise of less than 1% after the company confirmed its purchase of predictive analytics software maker Predikto, saying the deal reinforces its digital strategy. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
- Hewlett Packard Enterprise ( HPE ) was almost 5% lower after analysts at Bernstein cut their investment recommendation for the software company's stock to Market Perform from Outperform.
